title: Fred Dibnah laddering a chimney (Part 1)
summary: Fred Dibnah, the English steeplejack, shows how ladders are fixed up the outside of a tall brick mill chimney. The footage was filmed in the mid-1990s and is part one of two.
why: People point to it as a vivid explanation of how industrial chimneys were climbed for inspection and repair.

quote.text: there is a great series showing how industrial chimneys made of brick were climbed for inspection and repair.
